tabs.tab_title: What exactly does the guarantee cover?
tabs.tab_content: [Plain-English summary of the guarantee: what’s guaranteed, how it’s measured, and what happens if it’s missed.]

Real marketing compounds. SEO, brand recognition, reviews and automation take time to build momentum. Six months is enough to show measurable results, and short enough that you’re never locked in for years.

tabs.tab_title: How is this different from the last agency I hired?
tabs.tab_content: A complete strategy instead of disconnected tactics, reporting tied to leads and revenue, a capped client list, and results guaranteed in writing.

tabs.tab_title: Do I own my accounts, website and content?
tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM] Yes. Everything we build for your business belongs to your business.

tabs.tab_title: What if I’m not ready for a partnership?
tabs.tab_content: Start with the BeFirst Community or 1:1 coaching. Many partners start there and move up when they’re ready to hand it off.
